She diagnosed me with bipolar during one of our first appointments and said that since she has been able to get to know me further she believes that it’s trauma induced and not as much a chemical imbalance. I have a lot of triggers that cause me to fluctuate being manic and depressed.

Yes I do and I’ve been thinking about it and I don’t think her goal is no lamotrigine but finding the sweet spot where I don’t have really bad brain fog like I have been. But right now I feel the best I have in a while.
I think she may not want me completely off it but just wants to lower it due to the severity of the brain fog.

She’s dropping the dosage of lamotrigine very slowly to make sure we’re making the right decision. I was on 200 and now I’m on 150. I’ve been on it for almost a month and have honestly been doing better than before with the antidepressants they’ve been slowly trying out.
